question: Does DBI achieve full detlog-stack/heap/INFO parity vs ptrace, not just stdout/exit?
method: same binary both backends; env -i pinned (6 vars); boxed via hermit-box-run; --strict --detlog-stack --detlog-heap --log info
result: INFO parity 0/6, stack 0/6, heap no-result 6/6; all explained by 3 plumbing/determinization gaps, none by guest behaviour

gaps.GAP-1: --log-file silently ignored on DBI; log goes to stderr (ptrace 85149B logfile/0 stderr vs dbi ABSENT/375 DETLOG stderr; 123 [memory] records each side)
gaps.GAP-2: DBI lines carry no wall-clock prefix; extract_log_messages splits on it, so the stream collapses to 1 message
gaps.GAP-3: dtid is the raw HOST TID under DBI: 7 distinct values across 7 runs vs ptrace constant dtid 3 -- determinism bug, makes log parity impossible by construction
